description: This PHP class `CustomerDao` is a data access object responsible for handling CRUD operations and complex queries related to Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It interacts with the database to fetch, save, delete, and search customers, as well as retrieving related project and timesheet information.

classes.name: CustomerDao
classes.description: A data access object for managing Customer entities, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and complex search functionalities.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves an active Customer entity by its ID, returning null if not found or inactive.

methods.name: getExistingCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing Customer IDs from the provided array, filtering out deleted customers.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Soft deletes customers by their IDs after checking for associated timesheet items; also deletes related projects and activities within a transaction.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Persists a Customer entity to the database.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Searches for customers based on filter parameters and returns an array of Customer entities.

methods.name: getSearchCustomerPaginator
methods.description: Configures and returns a paginator for customer search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: isCustomerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a customer name is already taken, optionally excluding a specific customer ID (useful for updates).

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by ID, regardless of deletion status.

methods.name: getCustomerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of customer IDs, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: getCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns customer IDs associated with a specific Project Admin's employee number, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: hasCustomerGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks whether a customer has any associated timesheet items.

methods.name: getUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns customer IDs that are associated with existing timesheet items, making them unselectable for certain operations.
